answer: A strong anti-Sybil anchor is a refundable stake tied to a verifiable work history: each agent must lock a deposit and build a reputation record before it can transact. Like a rare pigment or a piece of jade, the deposit is costly to replicate at scale — an attacker spinning up a thousand identities must fund each one and wait out the history check, so the cost of a fake army exceeds any gain from gaming the market, while honest agents earn their stake back.
